kata.name: memento roundtrip (a): a required field dropped by the restore map - every valued cell of snap_word_count is named
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the restore map's null assignment is named cell by cell; the sampled checklist misses the field

expected.detail: the restore map assigns the required snap_word_count arrow null; every valued source cell is a lost_cell finding with its row witness

commands: python3 prototype/memento_roundtrip_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: 4 faults, unique [0, 2, 2, 4] (baseline arm frozen)
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- migrate --json fixtures/katas/memento-roundtrip/restore-dropped-field.ct.json  # exit 8, 2 lost_cell findings
cargo test -q -p catherine-ledger --test memento_roundtrip_kata dropped_field  # ok: lost cells snap_word_count rows 0,1

comparison.conventional_baseline: A field-by-field save/restore checklist over sampled cells: snap_word_count is outside the sample (title, page text, tags, subtitle, note), so the dropped required field produces no detection.

procedure: 1. The fault set and its expectations were committed in fixtures/katas/memento-roundtrip/README.md and faults.json before any run; the observed-results section was appended after the executed run.

2. The baseline arm (prototype/memento_roundtrip_baseline.py, sha256 above) was executed first: a field-by-field save/restore checklist over the pre-registered sample cells; --assert froze its detections.

3. The probe arm ran the same fixtures through the real kernel: `catherine migrate --json` for the lost-data arm and `catherine_core::migrate::round_trip` in crates/catherine-ledger/tests/memento_roundtrip_kata.rs for the non-invertibility arm.
4. Elements were compared, not prose: lost_row:<object>#<row>, lost_cell:<arrow>#<row>, round_trip:<object>#<row>; an arm identifies an element only by naming it.

5. unique_detections = probe elements minus baseline-identified elements, re-derived by the frozen test; the verdict follows harness::derive_probe_verdict (empty unique = killed; unique + executed arm = survived).
